reaction_description: N-Diphenylmethylazetidin-3-ol was dissolved in methanol and contacted with hydrogen over Pd(OH)2/Al2O3 at 60 C in a batch hydrogenation reactor for 5 h.
raw_text: N-Diphenylmethylazetidin-3-ol was dissolved in methanol and contacted with hydrogen over Pd(OH)2/Al2O3 at 60 C in a batch hydrogenation reactor for 5 h. Acetic acid may be used to enhance the reaction rate. The 3-azetidinol product was obtained in 38.1% yield.
